description.value: Bigfoot Donuts is a family-owned artisan bakery and espresso bar that has anchored Downtown Courtenay since 2017, known for handcrafted, made-from-scratch donuts and in-house roasted coffee. The name pays homage to the Pacific Northwest and Indigenous Sasquatch/B'gwus traditions, reflecting the owners' deep roots in the Comox Valley — a family business lineage stretching back to 1920. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a full breakfast and lunch menu alongside espresso drinks and a rotating lineup of fresh baked goods.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces) at 43m; rack (2 spaces) at 73m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bigfoot Donuts is a real, operating artisan donut and coffee shop with an active online ordering system and a two-location expansion through 2024, supporting confirmed_open=true. The OSM phone (+1 250-871-6603) cannot be corroborated — the website only lists (250) 339-6330 for the Comox/Coffee Cabin location with no separate Courtenay number visible. The about page notes the Courtenay operation moved 'literally just next door' in 2022, raising doubt that 477 5th Street is still the current address; neither the specific street number nor the Courtenay phone is confirmed by the website. Takeout is confirmed via the explicit online pickup-order system; all other cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are absent from the website content.
concerns: OSM phone (+1 250-871-6603) not corroborated by website — website only lists (250) 339-6330 for the Comox/Coffee Cabin second location; Courtenay location phone is unconfirmed.
Address may be outdated: about page states the business moved 'literally just next door' from its original 5th Street space in 2022; OSM still shows 477 5th Street which may be the pre-2022 address.

Website location/hours block prominently features the Comox (Coffee Cabin) location, not the Courtenay 5th Street location — no Courtenay-specific address, phone, or hours are displayed on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating artisan bakery and café in Downtown Courtenay confirmed open via active website and 2024 expansion; a useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two locations exist: the original Courtenay 5th Street location (this OSM record) and a second location called Coffee Cabin by Bigfoot Donuts at 1466 Ryan Rd E, Comox, BC V9M 4E1, (250) 339-6330, opened 2024. The Coffee Cabin location may warrant its own OSM/directory entry.
